tagline: Lanmodulin displayed on yeast, harvested by light-triggered flocculation, deployed on-site as a tolling service for mine tailings
tagline_zh: 將 lanmodulin 展示於酵母表面，以光觸發絮凝收集菌體，並以現場代工服務的形式部署於礦場尾礦
summary: McGill engineered Saccharomyces cerevisiae EBY100 to display lanmodulin variants on its surface via the Aga1-Aga2 system for selective rare-earth binding, and to flocculate on command through a blue-light VP16-EL222 / C120 optogenetic circuit driving a truncated 678FLO1 flocculin, so that REE-loaded cells can be separated by gravity settling instead of centrifugation. Light-induced flocculation reached 66-75 percent against 24-25 percent in dark controls, and LanM surface display was confirmed by flow cytometry and confocal microscopy. The commercial case is a full industrial techno-economic analysis rather than a canvas: gate-to-gate CAPEX and OPEX, a unit cost of $11.83-20.58 USD per kg REO, a full-scale NPV case study on the Ashram tailings in Nunavik, Quebec, and seven separate sensitivity analyses. They were nominated for Best Entrepreneurship (Undergrad) and Best Biomanufacturing.
summary_zh: McGill 改造 Saccharomyces cerevisiae EBY100，透過 Aga1-Aga2 系統將 lanmodulin 變異體展示於細胞表面以選擇性結合稀土元素，並以藍光 VP16-EL222 / C120 光遺傳學迴路驅動截短的 678FLO1 絮凝素，使細胞可依指令絮凝，讓吸附稀土的細胞以重力沉降取代離心分離。光誘導絮凝達 66-75%，暗處對照組為 24-25%；LanM 表面展示則以流式細胞術與共軛焦顯微術確認。其商業論證是完整的工業級技術經濟分析，而不是一張商業模式圖：涵蓋 gate-to-gate 的資本支出與營運支出、每公斤 REO 11.83-20.58 美元的單位成本、以魁北克 Nunavik 的 Ashram 尾礦為對象的全規模 NPV 個案研究，以及七項獨立的敏感度分析。他們入圍 Best Entrepreneurship（大學部）與 Best Biomanufacturing。

dry.frameworks: Technology Readiness Levels (NASA nine-level scale, chosen specifically because Canadian cleantech and mining funding programmes gate on TRL) as the backbone of a four-phase staged development plan, each phase carrying goals, named partners, a funding figure and source, and a risk-and-mitigation table. Plus techno-economic analysis in three parts (gate-to-gate, full-scale case study, sensitivity), competitor tiering into direct, substitute and future, a four-option exit plan, a skill-gap analysis mapped against the advisory board, an IP and freedom-to-operate review, and a one-year incorporation plan with a one-pager.
dry.frameworks_zh: 以技術成熟度等級（TRL，NASA 的九級量表；之所以選用，是因為加拿大的清潔科技與礦業補助計畫都以 TRL 作為門檻）作為四階段分期開發計畫的骨幹，每一階段都列出目標、具名合作夥伴、資金金額與來源，以及風險與緩解對策表。此外還有分成三部分的技術經濟分析（gate-to-gate、全規模個案研究、敏感度分析）、把競爭者分為直接、替代與未來三層的分析、四種選項的退場計畫、對照顧問團成員盤點的技能缺口分析、智慧財產權與 freedom-to-operate 檢視，以及附一頁式簡介的一年期公司設立計畫。
dry.dataviz: A tabbed entrepreneurship page with a Sankey flowchart of critical-materials flows, a rare-earth demand-and-project-gap chart, a TEA workflow flowsheet, CAPEX/OPEX tables for both gate-to-gate and full-scale cases, a financial-analysis panel, and seven sensitivity charts (adsorption capacity, desorption efficiency, product purity discount, feedstock grade, yeast dosing concentration, PLS pH, discount rate), plus a tolling-model process diagram and an advisory-board gallery.
dry.dataviz_zh: 以分頁呈現的創業頁面，包含關鍵原料流向的 Sankey 流程圖、稀土需求與專案缺口圖、技術經濟分析的工作流程圖、gate-to-gate 與全規模兩種情境的資本支出與營運支出表、財務分析面板，以及七張敏感度圖表（吸附容量、脫附效率、產品純度折價、原料品位、酵母投加濃度、PLS pH 值、折現率），另有代工模式的製程示意圖與顧問團名錄。
dry.datascience: Genuinely industrial-grade analysis. Mass balances built in Excel at a PLS flowthrough of 1,200,000 cubic metres per year, 1 g/L REE and 80 percent target recovery; unit-cost benchmarking per kg TREO against solvent extraction, column-immobilised lanmodulin and a Caulobacter-based bioadsorbent; NPV of USD 51M over 15 years in the high-uptake case versus USD -0.2M in the low-uptake case, with payback of 2.6-5.9 years. The sensitivity work generates actual engineering targets: breakeven at about 23 mg/g adsorption capacity, rising to about 35 mg/g once a 20-30 percent impurity discount on mixed REO is applied; every 5 percent loss of desorption efficiency costs roughly USD 10M of project value; profitability is governed almost entirely by initial PLS pH rather than the bioadsorbent's operating pH; and the low-uptake case goes negative above a 15 percent discount rate. Separately, the TORCH dry-lab project runs GROMACS molecular dynamics with QM/MM to engineer the LanM binding site, including a real debugging story about periodic boundary conditions inflating RMSD tenfold.
dry.datascience_zh: 真正達到工業水準的分析。以 Excel 建立質量平衡，條件為 PLS 年處理量 1,200,000 立方公尺、稀土濃度 1 g/L、目標回收率 80%；並以每公斤 TREO 的單位成本，對照溶劑萃取、管柱固定化 lanmodulin 與以 Caulobacter 為基礎的生物吸附劑做基準比較；高採用情境下 15 年 NPV 為 5,100 萬美元，低採用情境為 -20 萬美元，回收期 2.6-5.9 年。敏感度分析產出的是真正可用的工程目標：吸附容量約 23 mg/g 為損益平衡點，若計入混合 REO 的 20-30% 雜質折價，門檻升到約 35 mg/g；脫附效率每下降 5%，專案價值約減少 1,000 萬美元；獲利能力幾乎完全取決於 PLS 的初始 pH 值，而不是生物吸附劑的操作 pH 值；折現率高於 15% 時，低採用情境就轉為負值。另外，乾實驗室的 TORCH 專案以 GROMACS 分子動力學搭配 QM/MM 改造 LanM 的結合位點，其中還包括一段真實的除錯經歷：週期性邊界條件讓 RMSD 被放大十倍。
dry.software: TORCH, a QM/MM and molecular-dynamics pipeline for optimising the lanmodulin binding site, with custom scripts for RMSD, clustering, radial distribution functions and explicit oxygen-distance coordination counting.
dry.software_zh: TORCH，一套用於最佳化 lanmodulin 結合位點的 QM/MM 與分子動力學流程，並自行撰寫程式計算 RMSD、分群、徑向分布函數，以及依氧原子距離明確計算配位數。
stack: S. cerevisiae EBY100 / pYD1 Aga1-Aga2 display
techniques: yeast surface display with FLAG-tag detection
blue-light-inducible flocculation and Helm's flocculation assay
REE adsorption and desorption from flocs
restriction-enzyme cloning with LiOAc/SDS yeast colony PCR
sulfuric acid leaching of real tailings samples

good.publicEngagement: They host their own annual synthetic-biology conference, On the Verge, themed in 2026 as 'On the Verge of Running Out: Building the Bioeconomy', deliberately assembling corporate industry leaders, startup founders, policy experts, researchers and students around resource extraction. They also ran school and summer-camp workshops (microbial painting, acid-base chemistry) and are responding to a teacher's request for more advanced genetic-engineering workshops by exploring chromoproteins for new colours.
good.publicEngagement_zh: 團隊自辦年度合成生物學會議 On the Verge，2026 年主題為 On the Verge of Running Out: Building the Bioeconomy，刻意圍繞資源開採議題，聚集企業界領袖、新創創辦人、政策專家、研究者與學生。他們也在學校與夏令營舉辦工作坊（微生物繪畫、酸鹼化學），並回應一位老師希望有更進階基因工程工作坊的請求，正嘗試以色素蛋白提供新的顏色選擇。
good.ihp: Over 100 stakeholders engaged, with a consultation map that traces who informed what and who they were referred to next, explicitly arguing that no consultation stands alone. The consequential ones are documented as reversals. They abandoned ultra-purification of REEs entirely after Dr. Michael Free and others showed the separation factor cannot support the claim and that the economics would hinge on only the last 0.9 percent of purity, repositioning instead on selective pre-solvent-extraction concentration. Feedstock choice came from Dr. Jayme Fehyl-Buska and Dr. Kevin Moran of CVW Sustainable Royalties; Ms. Julia Vilela Carvalho of UNEP steered them to fresh rather than legacy tailings for liability and environmental-regulation reasons; Peter van Alphen, Bastien Fresia and Gilles Roy of Nuvau Minerals Corp. confirmed mines have space and are used to disposing of new materials, which is why the process was designed around equipment mines already run, and recommended the tolling model. Protocol-level consultations repeatedly rescued failing experiments: Dr. Denzel Ignacia raised the flocculation induction OD to 3-5, Mira Loock supplied a surface-display-specific protocol at OD 0.8-1.2 that finally produced positive metal-binding results, Michael Bellucci spotted restriction sites less than 30 bp apart as the reason digests failed. Jan Morrill of Earthworks pushed back on their sustainability framing by insisting re-mining can inflict the same harm as direct mining and taught them a Free, Prior and Informed Consent framework. Dr. Yvette Baninla widened the analysis to the geopolitics of offshore REE processing and Indigenous consultation.
good.ihp_zh: 接觸超過 100 位利害關係人，並以一張諮詢地圖標示誰影響了哪一項決定、又被轉介給誰，明確主張沒有任何一次諮詢能獨立成立。真正造成影響的諮詢，都以推翻原案的形式記錄下來。在 Dr. Michael Free 等人指出分離因子無法支撐其主張、而且經濟性其實只取決於純度最後的 0.9% 之後，團隊徹底放棄稀土超高純度精煉，改將定位轉向溶劑萃取前的選擇性濃縮。原料選擇來自 CVW Sustainable Royalties 的 Dr. Jayme Fehyl-Buska 與 Dr. Kevin Moran；UNEP 的 Ms. Julia Vilela Carvalho 以責任歸屬與環境法規為理由，引導他們選擇新產生的尾礦而非舊有尾礦；Nuvau Minerals Corp. 的 Peter van Alphen、Bastien Fresia 與 Gilles Roy 確認礦場有足夠空間、也習慣處置新產生的物料，這正是製程被設計成圍繞礦場既有設備的原因，他們並建議採用代工模式。實驗流程層面的諮詢一再救回失敗的實驗：Dr. Denzel Ignacia 建議把絮凝誘導的 OD 提高到 3-5；Mira Loock 提供專為表面展示設計、在 OD 0.8-1.2 進行的實驗流程，終於做出金屬結合的陽性結果；Michael Bellucci 看出限制酶切位相距不到 30 bp 正是切割失敗的原因。Earthworks 的 Jan Morrill 反駁他們的永續論述，強調再開採可能造成與直接開採同等的傷害，並教他們自由、事先與知情同意（FPIC）的框架。Dr. Yvette Baninla 把分析擴及稀土境外加工的地緣政治與原住民族諮詢議題。
good.realWorld: Among the strongest commercialisation cases in iGEM 2026, and the only one in this group with real third-party commitments on paper. The business model is a B2B on-site tolling service: the mine keeps ownership and legal liability for its tailings, LanTurn operates a small modular plant on site and returns a concentrated mixed rare earth oxide, which avoids transport cost and keeps tailings-management liability off LanTurn's books. That model was recommended by Nuvau Minerals Corp. and then re-validated at the REM3 Executive Summit with potential offtakers and feedstock providers. Unit economics are properly built rather than asserted: $11.83-20.58 USD per kg REO gate-to-gate, with about 92 percent of CAPEX in desorption columns and resins and 54-68 percent of OPEX in fermentation, compared against solvent extraction (at worst 12 percent more expensive, at best 370-720 percent cheaper on impure low-grade feedstock), column-immobilised lanmodulin (16-100 percent cheaper) and a lanthanide-binding-tag bioadsorbent. The design choices are individually cost-justified, which is rare: surface display versus purified LanM in agarose resin, flocculation versus continuous centrifugation (though they honestly note this saves only $0.21 per kg TREO and is 'not hugely significant'), and light induction versus copper, ethanol or galactose. The Ashram case study is a real deposit with 51 Mt of flotation tailings at about 0.4 percent TREO, giving a USD 51M NPV over 15 years with a 2.6-year payback in the optimistic case and a marginally negative NPV with a 5.9-year payback in the pessimistic case, and they say so rather than quoting only the good number. The headline $560 billion of locked value in tailings is derived, not borrowed: tailings tonnage times REE concentration times market prices, with a 70 percent discount applied for mixed rather than pure REEs, and they immediately contextualise it against a global REE market of only about USD 4.5 billion. Institutional traction is concrete: entry into the Dobson Lean Startup Accelerator at McGill's Dobson Centre for Entrepreneurship in September 2026, ongoing mentorship from Felicity Meyer, a cleantech investment manager at BoxOne Ventures, guidance from Chris Corkery on McGill's research-commercialisation and tech-transfer route, an eleven-person advisory board spanning hydrometallurgy, mining, VC, biomanufacturing and regulatory affairs, published letters of support from Bastien Fresia of Nuvau Minerals Corp. and Dr. Boyd Davis of Kingston Process Metallurgy, real tailings samples already secured from a large Canadian mining company that plans to continue research with them, and named scale-up facilities (Concordia Bioprocessing Facility at 1000 L, KPM's 10,000 sq ft Kingston pilot plant and its biomining division launching 2027, a Sudbury bioleaching facility). The funding plan is staged and specific: about $28,800 across four quarters for the laboratory phase from university funds and non-dilutive grants (NSERC, NRC IRAP, NFRF), then angel and cleantech VC after incorporation, with later phases pointing at NRCan's CMRDD programme (typically $4M+ for TRL 6-8) and MICA Canada (up to $2.5M for TRL 7-9), benchmarked against actual biomining raises (Allonnia USD 20M Series A, pH7 USD 32M Series B). The IP work is the real thing rather than a slogan: they checked that the foundational yeast surface-display patents US6699658B1 and US7465787B2 have expired, identified live LanM patents (CA3170828A1, CA3223988A1, US20240183787A1) and a pending Princeton application WO2025240129A2 that explicitly claims EL222/C120 optogenetics in S. cerevisiae, and concluded they must differentiate technically, disclose to McGill's Tech Transfer Office before publishing anything patentable, and run a formal freedom-to-operate analysis. Blunt caveats: there is no incorporated company yet, only a one-year incorporation plan; no revenue, no signed tolling contract and no term sheet; and they state outright that many TEA parameters are literature estimates rather than their own measurements, which is exactly why the sensitivity analysis exists as a de-risking to-do list for the wet and dry labs. Their ethical self-assessment is unusually unflattering, admitting LanTurn neither remediates tailings nor meaningfully reduces their volume, that re-mining can reintroduce mining harms to communities that have not seen a project for decades, and that the rare earths will mostly end up in consumer goods and defence rather than the clean-energy story, with a stated commitment not to market it otherwise.
good.realWorld_zh: 是 iGEM 2026 中商業化論證最紮實的隊伍之一，也是本組唯一有第三方書面承諾的隊伍。商業模式是 B2B 的現場代工服務：尾礦的所有權與法律責任留在礦場，LanTurn 在現場營運一座小型模組化廠房，交回濃縮的混合稀土氧化物，既省去運輸成本，也讓尾礦管理責任不落在 LanTurn 帳上。這個模式由 Nuvau Minerals Corp. 建議，之後又在 REM3 Executive Summit 上與潛在買方和原料供應者再次驗證。單位經濟是算出來的，不是喊出來的：gate-to-gate 每公斤 REO 11.83-20.58 美元，其中約 92% 的資本支出在脫附管柱與樹脂，54-68% 的營運支出在發酵；並與溶劑萃取（最差情況貴 12%，最好情況在不純的低品位原料上便宜 370-720%）、管柱固定化 lanmodulin（便宜 16-100%）以及鑭系結合標籤生物吸附劑比較。設計選擇逐項都有成本依據，這相當少見：表面展示對比固定於 agarose 樹脂的純化 LanM、絮凝對比連續離心（不過他們老實指出這只省下每公斤 TREO 0.21 美元，並不特別顯著），以及光誘導對比銅、乙醇或半乳糖誘導。Ashram 個案研究用的是真實礦床，有 51 Mt 浮選尾礦、TREO 品位約 0.4%；樂觀情境下 15 年 NPV 為 5,100 萬美元、回收期 2.6 年，悲觀情境下 NPV 略為負值、回收期 5.9 年，而他們把兩者都講出來，不只引用好看的數字。尾礦中鎖住 5,600 億美元價值這個標題數字是自己推導的，不是引用來的：尾礦噸數乘以稀土濃度乘以市場價格，並因為是混合稀土而非純稀土而打了 70% 折扣，接著立刻把它與全球稀土市場僅約 45 億美元的規模並列對照。機構層面的進展也很具體：2026 年 9 月進入 McGill Dobson Centre for Entrepreneurship 的 Dobson Lean Startup Accelerator；BoxOne Ventures 清潔科技投資經理 Felicity Meyer 持續提供指導；Chris Corkery 就 McGill 的研究商業化與技術移轉路徑提供建議；十一人顧問團涵蓋濕法冶金、礦業、創投、生物製造與法規事務；公開 Nuvau Minerals Corp. 的 Bastien Fresia 與 Kingston Process Metallurgy 的 Dr. Boyd Davis 的支持信；已從一家大型加拿大礦業公司取得真實尾礦樣品，對方並打算與他們繼續合作研究；放大生產設施也都指名（Concordia Bioprocessing Facility 的 1000 L 規模、KPM 位於 Kingston 的 10,000 平方英尺試量產廠及其 2027 年成立的生物採礦部門、Sudbury 的生物浸出設施）。募資計畫分階段而且寫得很細：實驗室階段四個季度約需 28,800 美元，來自校內經費與不稀釋股權的補助（NSERC、NRC IRAP、NFRF）；公司設立後再找天使與清潔科技創投；後續階段則指向 NRCan 的 CMRDD 計畫（TRL 6-8 通常為 400 萬美元以上）與 MICA Canada（TRL 7-9 最高 250 萬美元），並以實際的生物採礦募資案做對照（Allonnia 的 2,000 萬美元 A 輪、pH7 的 3,200 萬美元 B 輪）。智慧財產權的工作是真做而不是口號：他們查證酵母表面展示的基礎專利 US6699658B1 與 US7465787B2 已到期，找出仍有效的 LanM 專利（CA3170828A1、CA3223988A1、US20240183787A1），以及 Princeton 一件尚在審查的申請案 WO2025240129A2，該案明確主張在 S. cerevisiae 中使用 EL222/C120 光遺傳學，並據此結論他們必須在技術上做出區隔、在發表任何可專利內容前先向 McGill 技術移轉辦公室揭露，並進行正式的 freedom-to-operate 分析。保留事項也講得直白：公司尚未設立，只有一份一年期的設立計畫；沒有營收、沒有簽定的代工合約、也沒有投資條件書；他們並直言技術經濟分析中許多參數是文獻估計值而非自己量測的結果，而這正是敏感度分析存在的理由：它是給濕實驗室與乾實驗室的降風險待辦清單。他們的倫理自我評估罕見地不替自己說話，承認 LanTurn 既沒有修復尾礦，也沒有實質減少尾礦量；再開採可能把採礦的傷害重新帶回那些幾十年沒有新礦場的社區；而這些稀土多數會流向消費產品與國防，而不是清潔能源的故事，並明確承諾不會用後者來行銷。

images.caption_zh: 位於魁北克 Nunavik 的 Ashram 稀土專案規劃案，被選為示範案例，因為其尾礦對現有方法來說太稀，但對 LanTurn 已足夠富集

gemsTakeaway: Run the techno-economic analysis early and let its sensitivity results set the lab's experimental targets: McGill's TEA produced a hard number (about 35 mg/g adsorption capacity once the mixed-oxide impurity discount is applied) that became the wet lab's de-risking goal, which is how commercialisation work earns its place rather than sitting beside the science. Pair that with their TRL-staged plan, where each phase names its funding figure, funding source and named partner facility, so an institution can see exactly what the next stage costs and who must say yes.
gemsTakeaway_zh: 及早做技術經濟分析，並讓敏感度分析的結果來設定實驗室的實驗目標：McGill 的技術經濟分析算出一個硬指標（計入混合氧化物雜質折價後約 35 mg/g 的吸附容量），這個數字成為濕實驗室的降風險目標；商業化工作要這樣才站得住腳，而不是擺在科學旁邊各做各的。再搭配他們以 TRL 分期的計畫，每一階段都寫明資金金額、資金來源與具名的合作設施，讓機構一眼就看出下一階段要花多少錢、需要誰點頭。
